# Description

Please describe your pull request in detail.

Target `main` from a working branch. Follow the [release process](../docs/release-process.md).

## Related Issue

This project only accepts pull requests related to open issues.

* Discuss new features or changes in an issue first; bug reports should include reproduction steps.
* Keep release-tracking issues open through beta and stable publication. Use `Related to #<issue>` rather than an auto-closing reference when the issue is still needed for release preparation.

_Please link to the issue here_

## Motivation and Context

Why is this change required? What problem does it solve?

## How Has This Been Tested?

Record exact commands and their results, the test environment (OS, architecture, and PowerShell version), and any checks not run with a reason. Do not mark pending or unrun tests as passed.

| Command or workflow run | Result | Environment / run URL |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <!-- Exact command or workflow run --> | <!-- Passed, failed, pending, or not run (reason) --> | <!-- Environment or run URL, including tested commit --> |

* Run focused Pester tests for changed behavior; use `./ci/Test-Module.ps1` for full secret-free validation on disposable Windows machines. Its default run excludes `Intune`, `MDT`, and `ConfigMgr`-tagged tests; redistributable integration tests install/uninstall runtimes.
* For module changes, run PSScriptAnalyzer with `.rules/PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1`; preserve Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7 compatibility.
* CI runs automatically only when `VcRedist/**` or `tests/**` changes. For documentation-, CI-script-, or workflow-only PRs, record applicable checks and any manual validation run. Resolve missing required checks before merging; do not assume skipped CI passed.
* Ordinary PR validation excludes live Intune tests. Publishing runs them separately before environment approval.

## Types of changes

Select all that apply:
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation or help
- [ ] Tests, CI, or maintenance
- [ ] Release preparation (beta, release candidate, or stable)

## Checklist:

Complete applicable items; explain anything not applicable or not run in the description or testing section.

## Release preparation only

<!-- Leave this checklist unchecked for ordinary development PRs. For generated release PRs, complete it during review; preparation's focused tests do not replace the full Validation gate. -->

- [ ] This PR was generated by **Prepare module release** on `main` with the intended `version`, optional `prerelease`, and an open `issue`.
- [ ] The `release/<full-version>` branch, module manifest, first numbered changelog section, and generated `docs/versions.md` agree.
- [ ] The prerelease label is correct for a beta/RC, or removed for stable; earlier release notes are preserved.
- [ ] I have reviewed all generated changes and confirmed full **Validation gate** success before merging.

Merging this PR does **not** publish. After merging, a maintainer separately dispatches **Publish module to PowerShell Gallery** on `main` with the exact `v<full-version>` tag and, preferably, the full merged commit SHA. Publishing revalidates that commit, including live Intune tests, and requires approval in the `powershell-gallery` environment before creating the tag and publishing. Stable promotion requires its own preparation PR and publication; it does not overwrite or relabel a beta.
